title: Tower of Hanoi (Move Count)
summary: Count the moves needed to shift n disks: move n - 1 disks aside, move the biggest disk once, then move the n - 1 disks back on top.

inputs.name: n
inputs.label: Number of disks
inputs.note: From 1 to 7 (fewer on the lite profile).

anchors.label: Move the smaller stack back on top
